# kind-calico's parts (scripts/ci-suite.sh kind-calico-<part>): each part is a cluster of its own, Calico's, running the
# kube-tagged tests listed for it here, then Envoy's lost-entries check; the last part runs the hand-off journey after its
# tests. Every test make test-kube RUN=TestKind runs is on exactly one line (internal/tools/suites: TestTheCalicoPartsCoverTheKindTests).
# Balanced by the tests' times on Canyon's runners (2026-11-25): about 10 minutes of tests a part, the journey's 5 counted.
# <part> <test>
1 TestKindCheckMetadataReachesTheReceiver
1 TestKindAppReachesOnlyEnvoy
1 TestKindTrivyScansThroughItsServer
1 TestKindChoice1ALBPodStartsUnderEmptyAllowlist
1 TestKindSigninRuleFromTheChart
1 TestKindLogsReadACrashedAppsLastRun
1 TestKindStopIsIdempotent
1 TestKindAppsReachNoOtherAppNorTheControlPlane
1 TestKindOnlyTheExecutorReadsBuilds
1 TestKindRebaseIsKpacksBuildAndRefusesFirst
2 TestKindSigninPastTheGateway
2 TestKindSilentConnectionsAreClosed
2 TestKindANarrowingRefusesFromItsAnswer
2 TestKindTunnelWritesItsRowBeforeItsLastEntry
2 TestKindChoice1OIDCPodStartsUnderEmptyAllowlist
2 TestKindLogsReadTheEndKeptOfAGoneRun
2 TestKindProbeTellsEnforcement
2 TestKindBuildsReachNoPrivateNorLinkLocalAddress
2 TestKindLogsReadTheAppContainerAlone
3 TestKindChoice2PodStartsUnderEmptyAllowlist
3 TestKindCallWithoutTokenRefused
3 TestKindAppPortOnlyThroughTheSidecar
3 TestKindAccessReachesThePodWithoutARestart
3 TestKindTheRouterSaysWhyItCannotReachAnApp
3 TestKindExecutorReadsNoSecret
3 TestKindPodSecurityRefusesWhatEachNamespaceForbids
